s001.text: Chase was a full participant in Thursday's practice with no injury designation. He has drawn double-digit targets in four straight games and remains the clear focal point of the Cincinnati passing attack.

s002.text: Higgins is listed as questionable with a hamstring issue and was limited in practice all week. Coaching staff indicated a game-time decision; a reduced snap count is expected even if he suits up.

s003.text: Jefferson carries no injury designation into a divisional matchup with playoff seeding on the line. Minnesota is expected to lean on the passing game against a defense that has struggled against outside receivers.

s004.text: Adams was limited Wednesday with a knee issue but told reporters he expects to play. The Jets have been rotating snaps more aggressively late in the season.

s005.text: Evans is fully healthy and has scored in three consecutive games. Tampa Bay has a defined role for him in the red zone.

s006.text: Thomas remains the Jacksonville target leader with no injury designation, though the quarterback situation adds week-to-week variance to his projection.

s007.text: Nabers cleared the concussion protocol and is expected to play a normal complement of snaps. His target share has been among the highest in the league since returning.

s008.text: Jeudy has seen elevated volume with Cleveland trailing in most game scripts. No injury designation this week.

s009.text: Gibbs is healthy and has handled a season-high snap share over the last three weeks as Detroit's backfield workload has consolidated.

s010.text: Robinson carries no injury designation and continues to see three-down usage including passing situations.

s011.text: Jacobs is questionable with an ankle sprain suffered late last week. He was limited in two of three practices and Green Bay has a capable backup ready for a larger role.

s012.text: Taylor is off the injury report after a full week of practice and should return to a bell-cow workload.

s013.text: With Baltimore's playoff seeding already decided, the coaching staff declined to commit to a full workload for Henry. Snap-count risk is elevated this week.

s014.text: Achane is healthy and has been heavily involved as a receiver, giving him a higher floor in PPR formats than his rushing volume alone would suggest.

s015.text: Cook is listed as questionable and Buffalo has clinched, raising the possibility of a rest-week workload reduction.

s016.text: Irving has out-snapped the veteran back in each of the last four games and carries no injury designation.

s017.text: Jackson is healthy but Baltimore has not ruled out limiting starters with seeding secured. Treat the projection as carrying more downside than usual.

s018.text: Daniels carries no designation and Washington still has something to play for. His rushing floor has been the most consistent part of his production.

s019.text: Burrow is fully healthy and Cincinnati needs a win to stay alive, pointing to a full workload and a pass-heavy script.

s020.text: Goff has no injury designation ahead of a divisional matchup that decides the top seed.

s021.text: Darnold is healthy. Minnesota's offense has been more efficient at home, and the matchup carries significant playoff implications.

s022.text: Nix is off the injury report. Denver faces one of the league's stronger pass defenses, which caps the ceiling despite a healthy designation.

s023.text: Bowers is healthy and has been the clear target leader for Las Vegas, drawing volume that is unusual for the tight end position.

s024.text: McBride carries no injury designation and continues to run a route on nearly every dropback.

s025.text: Andrews is questionable with an ankle issue and Baltimore may rest starters. Two independent sources of downside stack here.

s026.text: LaPorta is healthy but has seen his target share dip as Detroit's receiving corps has gotten healthier.

s027.text: Kittle is listed as questionable with a rib injury and was limited in practice. San Francisco is eliminated from playoff contention.

s028.text: Smith has no injury designation and has been used heavily in the short passing game with Miami's offense leaning on quick throws.
